name: Short Truffle — sharp 1h rise with falling Open Interest
description: Highlights a coin only when it is an extreme case of the Short model's own thesis in this frame: among the strongest 1h returns of the ranked universe, it actually rose, while its Open Interest is among the most-declining and actually fell (a rise not carried by new positions). Relative to the frame by construction: it says nothing about absolute opportunity quality. Thresholds are round numbers written down before any evaluation, not optimized.

conditions.rationale: The model's primary term (weight +1): within the strongest 5% of 1h returns this frame.
A reversal thesis needs an actual rise, not merely a relatively strong coin in a falling market.
The model's secondary term (weight -0.5): within the most-declining 20% of 1h Open Interest changes; looser than the primary term, as its weight is half.
Open Interest actually did not grow over the hour.
